description: Chinese consumer 3D printing company founded in 2014 in Shenzhen, selling FDM and resin 3D printers (Ender, K1 and CR series), 3D scanners, laser engravers, filaments and accessories through its official direct-to-consumer store and global warehouses.

evidence.summary: Creality's official affiliate page runs the program on two networks - Impact (recommended for new creator partners) and Awin (for existing and preferred publishers) - with monthly payouts, performance tiers, a dedicated affiliate manager and early product access; the page publishes no commission rate.

The official page explicitly recruits content creators - YouTube, TikTok and Instagram creators and bloggers are a named partner category - alongside review websites, tech media and maker/STEM communities.
Wikipedia lists Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd. as a Chinese 3D printer manufacturer founded in 2014 and headquartered in Shenzhen, selling consumer and industrial-grade 3D printers.

No commission rate is published on the official program page, and third-party directories quote conflicting figures for the program, so no rate is recorded; no earnings cap or creator count is published either, so cap and saturation are recorded as unknown.

name: Creality

reasons.compensation: No rate is published on the official page and directory figures conflict, so compensation scores low despite performance tiers being advertised.
reasons.contact_access: Two open network application routes (Impact and Awin) from one official program page, plus a named dedicated affiliate manager - strong access, just short of a public direct email.
reasons.credibility: One of the world's leading consumer 3D printing brands, founded 2014 in Shenzhen, with millions of printers shipped globally.
reasons.niche_fit: Consumer 3D printers, scanners and engravers are core maker/creator tech - product demos, builds and reviews are a staple of tech UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open on both networks with monthly payouts; approval is still required, so not a perfect score.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own program page names TikTok, YouTube and Instagram creators as a partner category and offers them early product access and a dedicated affiliate manager.

description: American direct-to-consumer e-bike brand selling stylish commuter and adventure electric bikes and accessories, known for minimalist designs with integrated displays showing speed, distance and battery life.

evidence.summary: UpPromote's bicycle affiliate directory lists Aventon's e-bike program on AvantLink at a 4% commission with a 30-day cookie, product data feeds and banner support; joining requires signing up for AvantLink.

CompareEPC's payout table lists Aventon Bikes via FlexOffers at 5% and Shopper quotes a generic 5-10% range - both conflict with the 4% AvantLink figure, so no single rate is recorded; no earnings cap or creator count is published, so both are unknown.
Shopper's partnership listing describes Aventon as a United States e-bike brand running an affiliate program that pays per sale.

name: Aventon

reasons.compensation: A 4% AvantLink rate is reported by one directory but conflicts with a 5% FlexOffers listing and a 5-10% range elsewhere, so the rate is unrecorded and compensation scores mid-low.
reasons.contact_access: The join route is a network application (AvantLink) documented in a public directory; no public brand-side affiliate contact was found.
reasons.credibility: Established US direct-to-consumer e-bike brand with national recognition in the commuter e-bike market.
reasons.niche_fit: E-bikes sit at the tech/outdoor lifestyle crossover and demo well on video, though the niche is narrower than core creator tech.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to join through AvantLink sign-up per the directory listing.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A documented affiliate program with data feeds and banners exists, but no creator-specific program or ambassador evidence was found.

description: American direct-to-consumer e-bike company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, known for affordable folding and step-through electric bikes popular with commuters, RVers and outdoor riders.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's eBike program directory lists Lectric Ebikes on the Impact platform at 3% commission per sale, available worldwide.

Skala's marketing breakdown documents that Lectric built its early growth on creator seeding - shipping prototype folding eBikes to RV YouTubers for honest reviews - and continues to treat influencer communities as a core channel.
CB Insights lists Lectric eBikes as founded in 2018 with headquarters in Phoenix, Arizona, selling foldable and step-through eBikes direct to consumers.

name: Lectric eBikes

reasons.compensation: A published directory rate exists (3% per sale on Impact) but it is a low percentage on a high-ticket product, so compensation scores mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Join route is the Impact network application as documented in the directory; no public brand-side affiliate email was found.
reasons.credibility: One of the best-known US DTC e-bike brands, founded 2018 in Phoenix with a large rider base.
reasons.niche_fit: Affordable folding e-bikes are highly demonstrable tech/lifestyle products with strong RV, commuting and outdoor creator communities.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is listed as open worldwide on Impact.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's growth was famously built on YouTuber seeding and reviews, and it runs a standing Impact affiliate program - solid creator evidence, though no formal ambassador page was found.

description: Chinese photography-gear brand founded in 2015, selling camera bags, tripods, quick-release mounts, straps and DJI drone and action-camera accessories designed for photographers, filmmakers and content creators in more than 100 countries.

evidence.summary: PGYTECH's Awin merchant profile runs its affiliate program on Awin with a product data feed, regular product launches and promotional opportunities; it publishes no fixed commission rate - only 'competitive commission rates' with basket-value tiers for selected partners - so no rate is recorded.

The Awin profile explicitly welcomes content creators, photography bloggers, gear review sites and creator-focused communities to join, and publishes an affiliate contact email (sales07@pgy-tech.com).

The same profile states a 90-day attribution period in its payments header but '30-day cookie tracking' in the program details - an internal inconsistency - and neither an earnings cap nor a creator count is published, so cap and saturation are recorded as unknown.

Brand summaries describe PGYTECH as a Chinese photography and creative-gear brand founded in 2015 (Kunshan Pugongying Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.), originally known for DJI drone accessories and now covering camera bags, tripods, mounts and creator everyday-carry products sold in over 100 countries.

name: PGYTECH

reasons.compensation: No rate is published - only 'competitive rates' and selective basket tiers - so compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate contact email on the Awin profile plus an open network application - top-band access.
reasons.credibility: Established global photography-accessory brand founded in 2015 and sold in 100+ countries, though smaller than the biggest camera brands.
reasons.niche_fit: Camera, drone and action-camera gear made specifically for photographers and video creators - a near-core creator-tech niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin; tiered rates are reserved for selected partners, which slightly limits the open offer.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The network profile explicitly recruits content creators and creator communities and the brand maintains active Instagram, TikTok and YouTube channels built around creator content.

description: Global charging brand founded in 2014 in Shenzhen, selling power banks, GaN chargers, cables and wireless chargers through its official store iniushop.com; the brand reports more than 40 million users across 174 countries.

evidence.summary: INIU's Awin merchant profile publishes the program terms: 8% commission on all qualifying purchases, a 30-day cookie, applications reviewed within 2-3 business days, and a named affiliate contact (gloria@iniu.tech).
The Awin profile explicitly welcomes review sites, online communities, bloggers and creators to promote INIU's charging products, and the brand's Instagram showcases creator-made product videos.
INIU's October 2026 press release describes a global charging brand founded in 2014 that has served more than 40 million users across 174 countries, selling through its official website iniushop.com.

name: INIU

reasons.compensation: A clear published rate - 8% on all qualifying purchases with a 30-day cookie - puts compensation in the upper-middle band.
reasons.contact_access: A named affiliate contact email published on the network profile plus an open Awin application - top-band access.
reasons.credibility: Large global charging brand (40M+ users, 174 countries) founded in 2014, though less premium-positioned than the biggest accessory names.
reasons.niche_fit: Power banks and fast chargers are staple, highly demonstrable creator tech accessories with broad everyday appeal.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application on Awin with a stated 2-3 business day review.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile welcomes creators and bloggers by name, and the brand actively features creator product videos on its social channels.

description: French premium cookware brand founded in 1925 in Fresnoy-Le-Grand, known for enameled cast iron Dutch ovens, stoneware, stainless steel cookware and kitchen accessories, sold in more than 60 countries including through lecreuset.com in the US.

evidence.summary: The Le Creuset program page reproduces the brand's US affiliate terms: the program runs on Pepperjam, is US-traffic only, and advertises earnings of 'up to 10%' commission - a ceiling rather than a flat rate, so no rate is recorded; social media promotion is allowed only case-by-case with program-manager approval.

The program page's brand history states Le Creuset was founded in 1925 in Fresnoy-Le-Grand, France, still produces all enameled cast iron cookware in the original foundry, and is sold in more than 60 countries.

Shopper's listing quotes a 1.86% payout for Lecreuset, which conflicts with the Pepperjam program's 'up to 10%' ceiling, confirming no single published rate can be recorded; no earnings cap or creator count is published, so both are unknown.

name: Le Creuset

reasons.compensation: Only an 'up to 10%' ceiling is published and another listing conflicts at 1.86%, so the rate is unrecorded and compensation scores mid-low.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the Pepperjam network; no public brand-side affiliate email was found.
reasons.credibility: Century-old premium cookware brand, founded 1925 in France and sold in 60+ countries - maximum credibility.
reasons.niche_fit: Iconic premium cookware is a centerpiece of food and home creator content, even though the brand skews classic rather than creator-first.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to US-traffic affiliates via Pepperjam, with approval and channel restrictions (social case-by-case).
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running affiliate program exists, but the terms allow social media promotion only case-by-case, so creator evidence is modest.

description: American premium home-furnishings brand founded in 2003 in Sausalito, California, selling coastal-style furniture, bedding, rugs, lighting and decor through its website and Design Shops nationwide.

evidence.summary: Serena & Lily's affiliate application runs on Partnerize (Ascend): the registration page asks applicants whether they are individuals who will be promoting brands on their personal social media or personal blog, confirming the program is open to creators and not only coupon or paid-search publishers.

Sovrn's merchant page states Serena & Lily's commission rates are not publicly disclosed and vary by product category and promotional period, while Shopper quotes a generic 5-10% range - so no rate is recorded; no earnings cap or creator count is published, so both are unknown.
CB Insights lists Serena & Lily as founded in 2003 and headquartered in Sausalito, California, providing home furnishings and accessories.

name: Serena & Lily

reasons.compensation: Rates are not publicly disclosed and third-party figures conflict, so compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: A public, direct application form on the network portal - good access, though no public email contact.
reasons.credibility: Established premium US home brand founded in 2003 with a national chain of Design Shops.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium coastal home furnishings and decor are a strong fit for home, interiors and lifestyle creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open through Partnerize/Ascend.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The application explicitly contemplates individuals promoting on personal social media and blogs, but no separate creator/ambassador program evidence was found.

description: Air-purifier brand selling high-performance home and office air cleaners through iqair.com in the US, with a customer Experience Center and a published affiliate program page on its own site.

evidence.summary: IQAir publishes its own Affiliate Program page on iqair.com (US store), confirming the brand runs a direct affiliate program; the program's network and detailed terms are not exposed in the public page text.

Shopper's partnership listing for IQAir quotes a 5% payout per sale with CPA tracking; no conflicting rate was found, so 5% is recorded as publicly reported. No earnings cap or creator count is published, so both are unknown.

name: IQAir

reasons.compensation: A single consistent published figure (5% per sale) with no conflicting source puts compensation mid-band.
reasons.contact_access: The program page is on the brand's own domain, but no public affiliate email or detailed application terms were exposed.
reasons.credibility: Long-established premium air-quality brand with a US Experience Center and national presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium air purifiers fit home, wellness and home-tech content, though the product category is narrower than decor or kitchen.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program page is public on the official US store; application mechanics are not detailed publicly.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An affiliate program exists on the brand's own site, but no creator-specific recruitment or ambassador evidence was found.

description: Premium pet food brand selling high-protein, low-carb dog and cat recipes with patented probiotics through its own store and pet retailers, marketed around performance nutrition for active pets and their owners.

evidence.summary: Nulo's official Social Ambassador Program page ('Team Nulo') recruits pet-parent athletes and creators: perks include opportunities for exclusive paid campaigns, potential bonus payments for whitelisting opportunities, a monthly product supply and featured content opportunities across Nulo's channels.

The program FAQ states ambassadors 'earn free product and direct cash' and requires athletes with at least 1,000 engaged followers; the program is US-only. No commission rate, earnings cap or cohort size is published, so the rate is unrecorded and cap/saturation are unknown - the 1,000-follower floor is an eligibility bar, not evidence of a small cohort.

name: Nulo

reasons.compensation: Paid campaigns and direct cash are promised on the brand's own page, but no rate or commission structure is published, so compensation scores mid-low.
reasons.contact_access: A public application page on the brand's own domain; no public email contact was found.
reasons.credibility: Established premium pet food brand with national retail distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium pet nutrition for active dogs and cats maps directly onto pet-parent creator content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are public but the program targets pet-parent athletes with at least 1,000 engaged followers and is US-only, narrowing availability.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal, public ambassador program with defined perks, featured-content opportunities and community calls - strong structured creator evidence.

description: Online pet supplies retailer selling food, toys, supplements, medications and specialty products for dogs, cats, birds, reptiles and small pets through entirelypets.com.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists the EntirelyPets affiliate program on CJ Affiliate at 6% commission per sale.

Lasso quotes a 3-10% commission range with a 30-day cookie and $50 payout threshold, and Shopper quotes 5-10% - both conflict with LinkClicky's 6% CJ figure, so no single rate is recorded; no earnings cap or creator count is published, so both are unknown.

EntirelyPets' own privacy policy describes its affiliate program - a partnership where the linking site receives a commission for every sale generated through its link - and publishes affiliates@entirelypets.com for affiliate questions.

name: EntirelyPets

reasons.compensation: Rates conflict across directories (6% on CJ vs 3-10% and 5-10% ranges), so the rate is unrecorded and compensation scores mid-low.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate email on the brand's own domain plus a network join route - strong access.
reasons.credibility: Long-running US online pet retailer with a broad catalog and its own accredited pharmacy operation.
reasons.niche_fit: A broad pet-supplies catalog fits pet creators generally, though a multi-brand retailer is a weaker niche match than a dedicated pet brand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open through CJ Affiliate per the directory listing.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A documented affiliate program exists, but no creator or ambassador program evidence was found.
